subject.title: feat: add readable names for managed worktrees

question: Should managed-worktree branch and checkout names be allowed to derive automatically from a session’s first message/title, or should semantic names require an explicit worktree label while unnamed sessions use a non-content-derived readable fallback?
rationale: This is a new default that moves session-derived text into durable Git and filesystem metadata, so correctness alone cannot establish the intended privacy and compatibility contract.

options.title: Require an explicit label for semantic names
options.body: Use an explicit worktree label as the only source of session-derived names and retain the readable crustacean fallback for unnamed creates.

options.title: Accept title-derived names
options.body: Keep generated first-message titles as the default name source and explicitly document the resulting metadata exposure and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Require an explicit label for semantic names
recommendation.body: Use an explicit worktree label as the only source of session-derived names and retain the readable crustacean fallback for unnamed creates.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal commit spans the gateway/session-title and managed-worktree boundary, making this the best available routing candidate from the supplied history.
